values.note: Online booking opens Feb 1 for the standard and extended season; unreserved sites are first-come any time, and off-season nights are first-come only. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.
Off-season nights are $20 at any site.

The standard season runs from two Fridays before Memorial Day (May 21 in 2027) to the Monday after Labor Day; staff may extend it from May 1 to Oct 31. After that, first-come off-season camping with electric only continues until snow closes the access road, which is groomed as a snowmobile trail.

note: Douglas County Forest park at the Gordon Dam, where the St. Croix River leaves the St. Croix (Gordon) Flowage; the start of the St. Croix National Scenic Riverway. Sites 17-30 sit on a wooded loop along the flowage shore. Boat and canoe launch, fish-cleaning house, swimming area, playground, and ATV/UTV trail access. --Claude
